title: DPP township council candidate dies after collapsing on stage
summary: Taipei, Sept. 23 (CNA) Chiu Feng-ing (邱鳳英), a Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidate for township councilor in Hualien County's Xincheng Township, died Wednesday morning after collapsing onstage at a Moon Festival event Tuesday night.

title: Honduran lawmaker visits Taiwan for training course: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Sept. 22 (CNA) A Honduran lawmaker who made a rare visit to Taiwan earlier this month was in the country to attend a training course organized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), a MOFA official in charge of the program said Tuesday.
